mechanism: Trazodone inhibits serotonin reuptake and isocarboxazid inhibits monoamine oxidase, creating severe risk of serotonin syndrome through synergistic serotonergic effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if both agents are necessary, trazodone must be discontinued at least 14 days before initiating isocarboxazid, or isocarboxazid must be stopped at least 14 days before starting trazodone.
